title: Why Does Your Phone Battery Die in the Cold? #Shorts
description:
30% and then dead the second you step outside? The charge is still in there. Cold thickens the liquid inside your battery, the lithium ions slow to a crawl, and the battery can't deliver power fast enough, so your phone shuts down. Warm it up and it comes back. Plus the one place to keep your phone this winter.

Explained in 60 #8
